processing.exception_reason: 1K vest baseColor failed predeclared full-image and UV-used MASK coverage limits; retain 2K rather than modify cutoff or alpha
processing.base_color: BOX averaging in linear light with premultiplied alpha, then unpremultiply and encode sRGB
processing.normal: BOX average tangent vectors then normalize; neutral +Z fallback for zero vector
processing.alpha: Preserve source alpha and material modes/cutoffs; record changed coverage and inspect actual GLB
processing.unchanged_dimensions: Keep original image bytes; never upscale

alpha_coverage_limits.scope: both full image and top-left UV-used footprint, cutoff 0.5
